findings.title: Migration body replaced with no-op for an already-applied/parallel migration
findings.body: The data migration 0917 is rewritten to `return` immediately, and 0920 is likewise gutted. If any environment already ran the original 0917 or 0920, their data conversion is silently skipped on future runs; and the comment references 0921_convert_org_saved_searches_to_views_rerevised, which is not part of this PR. Removing the real conversion without adding the referenced migration means org saved searches are never converted.

findings.title: Error IDs from the replay query are used without checking response shape; project_id unrelated
findings.body: `response[0].get("error_ids", [])` assumes process_raw_response returns a list of dicts for the replay; if the query returns no rows or error_ids is None, `error_ids` becomes None and is passed to fetch_error_details which iterates it, raising TypeError. The endpoint then 500s instead of degrading to no error context.

findings.title: zip of error_ids with nodestore results misaligns and drops ids
findings.body: `zip(error_ids, events.values())` assumes nodestore get_multi returns values in the same order as the requested node ids and includes a key for every id. `events.values()` order is not guaranteed to match, and missing nodes shift subsequent pairings, so error titles/timestamps can be attributed to the wrong event ids.

findings.title: Error events fetched with default placeholders when data missing
findings.body: `data.get("timestamp", 0.0)` defaults missing timestamps to 0, so error events with no timestamp are placed at the start of the timeline by gen_request_data rather than being skipped or handled explicitly.

findings.title: Strict validation now rejects reports that were previously accepted
findings.body: The endpoint used to accept any report dict and only record metrics. It now returns 422 for the whole batch if any single report fails validation (e.g., both timestamp and age present, unknown type, invalid URL). Browsers sending a batch will lose all metrics for a single malformed report, and the stricter `url`/`user_agent` requirements may reject real-world reports.

findings.title: Regex experiments removed but parameterization of ParameterizationRegex still referenced
findings.body: The ParameterizationRegexExperiment class and its branch in parametrize_w_experiments are removed, yet the `ParameterizationExperiment` type alias now only covers callable experiments. Any configured regex experiment (or the traceparent experiment option removed from options/defaults.py) would now fail at runtime with an AttributeError on `.run` taking a callback of the wrong type, and the removed option could still be referenced in code paths reading it.

findings.title: Prompt tells LLM the output limit but is not enforced; 'AT MOST 55 words' conflicts with max_output_tokens=150
findings.body: The prompt text was rewritten with contradictory guidance (for example 'Don't make overly generic statements' combined with the instruction to base summaries on 'proportional' themes), and the hard 55-word limit is only stated in the prompt, not enforced by parse_response. Output length is unchecked.

findings.title: Default autofix tuning changed from 'low' to 'off' globally
findings.body: DEFAULT_AUTOFIX_AUTOMATION_TUNING_DEFAULT and the project option default both change from 'low' to 'off', silently disabling autofix automation for all existing projects that rely on the default, with no migration or changelog and no clear product reason in the PR description.

findings.title: Logging event_data uses the workflow-specific event data variable
findings.body: The extra field renamed from event_data to workflow_event_data changes the logged payload; this is a behavior change in logs but the diff does not explain it and the earlier group-level event_data reference is lost for debugging.

findings.title: Owner handling in update() uses validated_data.get('owner') but create() does not validate owner belongs to org
findings.body: The owner field is accepted from user input and written directly to owner_user_id/owner_team_id without verifying the user or team belongs to the detector's organization or project. A caller could assign an owner outside the organization (the test test_owner_not_in_organization asserts rejection, but the validator adds no such check).

findings.title: Query key omits environment and type dependency inconsistencies; attributes can be stale
findings.body: The useQuery queryKey is derived from makeTraceItemAttributeKeysQueryOptions which excludes environment, while the queryFn uses a separately-computed projectIds; changing projects through `projects` prop vs selection can cause cached results to be returned for the wrong project set.

findings.title: Table widget path renders empty hardcoded data behind a feature flag
findings.body: When the 'use-table-widget-visualization' feature is on, the TableWidgetVisualization is rendered with columns=[] and empty tableData, ignoring result.data, so every dashboard table widget shows no data for flagged orgs.

findings.title: Removed Type rows from grouping variant display
findings.body: The 'Type' row with explanatory tooltips is removed from every variant type, losing information (variant type and explanation) that users used to see in the grouping info panel.

findings.title: Writable aggregate fields filtered with isBaseVisualize but read via yAxes
findings.body: The writable branch now filters by isBaseVisualize and flatMaps `visualize.yAxes`, while the readable branch uses `yAxis`; the mixing of Visualize (single yAxis) and BaseVisualize (yAxes) shapes means writable aggregate fields containing Visualize instances (which have yAxis, not yAxes) will be dropped from field refs.

findings.title: Analytics event name changed from underscore to dash, breaking existing tracking
findings.body: trackAnalytics('replay.view_html') is renamed to 'replay.view-html'; existing dashboards and queries on the old event name will stop receiving data.

findings.title: Gradient change alters appearance of right mask
findings.body: The transparent right-mask gradient changes from a white rgba pair to theme background, altering visuals in dark themes without a corresponding design justification.

findings.title: Comment typo 'segements' in new null-segment guard
findings.body: The new comment says 'segements' and the guard skips deletion of blobs entirely for null max_segment_id; the comment should state clearly that no segment blobs were ingested.
